disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting to an insured that the licensee is an adjuster representing an insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person licensed as a public adjuster shall not misrepresent to an insured that he or she is an adjuster representing an insurer in any capacity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging an insured a fee while also accepting an appointment by the insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensed public adjuster is prohibited from charging an insured a fee if the public adjuster accepts an appointment by the insurer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying commission or fee to a person required to be licensed but who is not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not pay a commission, service fee, or other valuable consideration to a person for investigating or settling claims in this state if that person is required to be licensed under this article and is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging more than ten percent of insurance settlement as compensation in a catastrophic disaster
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no public adjuster shall charge, agree to, or accept as compensation or reimbursement any payment, commission, fee, or other thing of value in excess of ten percent of any insurance settlement or proceeds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring, demanding, or accepting any fee or deposit prior to settlement of a claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No public adjuster shall require, demand, or accept any fee, retainer, compensation, deposit, or other thing of value prior to settlement of a claim.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting an insured during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not solicit, or attempt to solicit, an insured during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence, as defined in the insured's insurance contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unlicensed employee or representative to conduct business requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not permit an unlicensed employee or representative of the public adjuster to conduct business for which a license is required under this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a direct or indirect financial interest in any aspect of the claim other than the agreed fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not have a direct or indirect financial interest in any aspect of the claim, other than the salary, fee, commission, or other consideration established in the written contract with the insured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acquiring any interest in salvage of property subject to the contract without written permission after settlement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not acquire any interest in salvage of property subject to the contract with the insured unless the public adjuster obtains written permission from the insured after settlement of the claim with the insurer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Referring or directing the insured to repair services from a person with whom the adjuster has a financial interest or from whom the adjuster receives compensation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not refer or direct the insured to get needed repairs or services in connection with a loss from any person: (I) With whom the public adjuster has a financial interest; or (II) From whom the public adjuster may receive direct or indirect compensation for the referral.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Participating directly or indirectly in the reconstruction, repair, or restoration of damaged property being adjusted
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not participate directly or indirectly in the reconstruction, repair, or restoration of damaged property that is the subject of a claim adjusted by the public adjuster.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in activities presenting a conflict of interest, including financial interest in salvage or repair firms obtaining business from claims the adjuster is adjusting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not engage in any other activities that may reasonably be construed as presenting a conflict of interest, including soliciting or accepting any remuneration from, or having a financial interest in, any salvage firm, repair firm, or other firm that obtains business in connection with any claim the public adjuster has a contract or agreement to adjust.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking adjustment of a claim when not competent and knowledgeable as to the terms and conditions of the coverage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not undertake the adjustment of a claim if the public adjuster is not competent and knowledgeable as to the terms and conditions of the insurance coverage or if the adjustment of the claim otherwise exceeds the public adjuster's expertise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making oral or written material misrepresentations or false statements intended to injure any person in the insurance business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not knowingly make any oral or written material misrepresentations or statements which are false and intended to injure any person engaged in the business of insurance to any insured client or potential insured client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or acting as both a public adjuster and a company or independent adjuster on the same claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster, while licensed in this state, shall not represent or act as a company adjuster or independent adjuster on the same claim.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract or accepting a power of attorney that vests in the adjuster effective authority to choose repair persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not enter into a contract or accept a power of attorney that vests in the public adjuster the effective authority to choose the persons who perform repair work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Agreeing to any loss settlement without the insured's knowledge and consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A public adjuster shall not agree to any loss settlement without the insured's knowledge and consent.

definition_quote.value: A public adjuster is obligated, under his or her license, to serve with objectivity and loyalty the interest of his or her client alone and to render to the insured such information, counsel, and service, within the knowledge, understanding, and opinion in good faith of the licensee, as will best serve the insured's insurance claim needs and interests.

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: A business entity acting as a public adjuster is required to obtain a public adjuster license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated a licensed public adjuster responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and rules of this state.

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: A public adjuster shall not acquire any interest in salvage of property subject to the contract with the insured unless the public adjuster obtains written permission from the insured after settlement of the claim with the insurer.

surety_bond_required.quote: Before receiving a license as a public adjuster and for the duration of the license, the applicant shall secure evidence of financial responsibility in a format prescribed by the commissioner through a surety bond executed and issued by an insurer authorized to issue surety bonds in this state

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: Must be in the minimum amount of twenty thousand dollars

written_contract_required.quote: A public adjuster shall ensure that all contracts for the public adjuster's services are in writing and set forth all terms and conditions of the engagement.

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: the insured may rescind any contract or other form of agreement for representation in a property or casualty loss or claim if the insured exercises this right of rescission in writing addressed to the insurer and the public adjuster and puts the written rescission, postage prepaid, in the United States mail within seventy-two hours after signing a settlement representation agreement

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: A public adjuster shall not have a direct or indirect financial interest in any aspect of the claim, other than the salary, fee, commission, or other consideration established in the written contract with the insured.

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: A public adjuster shall not participate directly or indirectly in the reconstruction, repair, or restoration of damaged property that is the subject of a claim adjusted by the public adjuster.

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: A public adjuster shall not solicit, or attempt to solicit, an insured during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence, as defined in the insured's insurance contract.
